_comment: The vx_blob_* contract, written from velxio-chip.h and not from any one
runtime. Three suites replay this same table against the same
test_board_buses_blob_abi_pi.py (Linux boards). A row that answers
differently in one host is the per-engine divergence F4 removes.
scratchHex is the head of the chip's scratch buffer after the call; the
probe fills it with 0xEE before every read, so a byte still 0xEE is a byte

steps.why: a name the host never declared
a plain read copies exactly len
a read off the end truncates and leaves the rest of dst alone
offset AT the end copies nothing
offset past the end copies nothing
an unknown name has nothing to give
the empty name is not a blob
a zero-length read is a no-op
a write is visible to the next read
a write off the end stops at the end; the blob does not grow
only the two bytes that fit were stored
offset AT the end stores nothing
offset past the end stores nothing
and writing to it did not bring it into being
a zero-length write is a no-op

reads.why: the Linux host reaches the same blob over whole transactions
past the last byte the slave has nothing and the line reads ones
